aboutGame.title: What is Ballistic exe?
paragraphs: Ballistic exe is a high-intensity indie tactical action shooter built around realistic projectile physics, momentum-driven movement, and surgical shot placement. Moving away from traditional hitscan mechanics, the game simulates dedicated bullet mass, drag coefficients, trajectory drop, and material penetration.

Whether you are optimizing keybinds for slide-jumping, mastering recoil compensation across multiple weapon classes, or fine-tuning weapon attachments, our wiki provides verified breakdowns, technical stats, and tactical combat guides.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about Ballistic exe gameplay, mechanics, and setup.

items.question: What is Ballistic exe?
items.answer: Ballistic exe is a fast-paced indie tactical shooter focusing on realistic projectile physics, momentum-driven kinetic movement, and precise weapon handling instead of hitscan arcade combat.

items.question: How does the ballistics system work in Ballistic exe?
items.answer: Every bullet in Ballistic exe features dedicated projectile mass, muzzle velocity, drag decay, and material penetration. Over long distances, players must lead targets and account for gravity arc drop.

items.question: Where can I download and play Ballistic exe?
items.answer: You can download the Ballistic exe demo and access full game release details through official Steam and indie developer distribution channels.

items.question: What are the recommended PC settings for Ballistic exe?
items.answer: For optimal input response and smooth framerates in Ballistic exe, running an Intel i5 / Ryzen 5 processor, 16 GB RAM, and a GTX 1060 / RTX 2060 GPU on an SSD with high-refresh display settings is recommended.

items.question: Does Ballistic exe support custom keybindings and controllers?
items.answer: Yes, Ballistic exe features rebindable keyboard and mouse layouts for sprint, crouch-slide, and combat utilities, alongside gamepad mapping for standard twin-stick controller setups.
